banks.bank_definition_binding: Regenerated preparation receipts must fill exact bank hashes before fit; no source truth is bundled.

consumer_cli.memory_profile: one record at a time; no semantic batching substitution

receipt_provenance.local_imported_modules: module name, package-relative path, actual loaded path, bytes, and SHA-256 for the vendored strict loader and decoder closure
receipt_provenance.runtime: actual Python implementation/executable, torch/safetensors/numpy versions, device, and runtime descriptor binding

decoder_dependency_closure.import_reason: __init__.py imports access, io, and public_prefix before the source-bound positionwise decoder can load

loader_compatibility.policy: Preserve loader-required serialized metadata; new identity is bound in selection receipt/consumer manifest; never rename metadata.
loader_compatibility.synthetic_cpu_compatibility_check: pending actual new states and root resource window

missing_before_freeze: new B0 selected state bytes and SHA-256
new B1 selected state bytes and SHA-256
new B0/B1 selected steps and immutable model IDs
regenerated B0/B1 bank manifest hashes and fit manifest hashes
new schedule semantic hashes and runner-state hashes
actual E copy and tensor identity sidecar
selection receipt and post-selection expected prediction IDs/digests
two-copy measured byte equality and Agent2 clean restore receipt

current_fixed.role: new selected B0 fixed-readout decoder state

expanded_fixed.role: new selected B1 fixed-readout decoder state

identity_current_fixed.role: tensor identity sidecar for B0 state

identity_expanded_fixed.role: tensor identity sidecar for B1 state

smoke_expected.role: post-selection prediction IDs for both methods

required_sequence: select ordinary checkpoints from development validation
persist actual B0 and B1 state files during training and after selection
copy E, code, config, smoke fixture, identities, receipt, and expected outputs into primary package
measure complete primary package size and verify under cap
root copies complete package to Windows secondary only after authorization
Agent2 retrieves a clean create-only runtime from secondary
Agent2 checks file hashes, tensor identities, and both-method prediction IDs

scope.successor_policy: New model identity is required; old TRR-0011 metadata and missing PR20 states are not substitutes.

smoke.expected_output_generation: After ordinary new-model checkpoint selection only, via the same strict package loader used for restore and later fixed-readout inference.

starting_decoder.new_model_warning: This starting identity does not identify either selected rebuilt model.
starting_decoder.package_inclusion: not bundled; bind exact source identity in fit receipt

storage.failure_boundary_note: Windows NTFS copy protects against WSL reset/distro loss, not whole-host disk failure.
storage.size_estimate_basis: Current package skeleton files plus exact E bytes plus prior state sizes as planning estimates; final state bytes and all sidecars/output/manifest bytes must be measured.

tensor_identity.algorithm: JSON compact sorted {shape,dtype} UTF-8 prefix followed by contiguous CPU uint8 C-order bytes

training.selection_rule: Earliest strict maximum of domain-balanced public validation token accuracy; development/selection data only.
